about: DictaLM 3.0 (Dicta, arXiv 2602.02104) in Lumen's Hebrew model catalogue — plan W2.4. One entry per size. A value that was not verified from a primary source is null and listed under ownerChecks; scripts/dictalm3.mjs refuses to evaluate or propose a variant while any of its owner checks is open. Sizes and base models are from the paper's abstract (read 10.11.2026). `ramGB` is approximate (q4 weights plus context). `compareWith` is the model recommendOllamaModel({ hebrew: true, ramGB }) picks today at that variant's RAM (src/ai/modelCatalog.ts); `tools` says whether Lumen may route tool-calling agents to it: false until the agent eval shows the Ollama build answering tool calls (the paper says the chat models support them). A variant becomes the default only when its eval score beats that model by at least `minGainPoints`.
